def: Anecdotes collectively; a collection of anecdotes.All history, therefore, being built partly, and some of italtogether, upon anecdotage, must be a tissue of lies. De Quincey.
A method of going from one tack to another. See Boxhaul.
The quality or state of being compassionate.
Having a right heart or disposition.-- Right"-heart`ed*ness, n.
A preparation of fruit in sirup in such a manner as to preserveits form, either whole, halved, or quartered; as, a compote of pears.Littr
Liable to undergo a judicial examination; properly coming underthe cognizance of a court; as, a cause may be triable before onecourt which is not triable in another.
Growth from within; multiplication of cells by endogenousdivision, as in the development of one or more cells in the interiorof a parent cell.
The twelfth part of a troy pound.
